column1: # Agent-SDK adapter manifest — the popular agent frameworks Unbrowse ships a
# NATIVE-TOOL adapter for: Unbrowse's resolve/execute/search exposed in each
# framework's own tool type, so an agent author registers Unbrowse with one import.
# Chosen by real adoption research (June 2026): Vercel AI SDK (~20M/mo, dominant),
# LangChain JS (largest ecosystem), Mastra (built on AI SDK), LlamaIndex TS (RAG),
# OpenAI Agents SDK. MCP is already a native protocol surface (`npx unbrowse mcp`)
# and is documented rather than packaged.
# A row is GREEN (scripts/agent-sdk-parity-gate.sh) only when ALL of:
#   ATTR  its README names the upstream framework (framework_npm)
#   TOOL  its README documents registering Unbrowse as the framework's tool
#   TEST  its shape test passes (the framework's tool contract is provided)
# columns:  framework_npm <TAB> unbrowse_pkg <TAB> pkg_path <TAB> readme <TAB> shape_test
